name: Photoview
short_desc: Personal photo and video gallery that reads your existing folders, with RAW support, EXIF parsing, face recognition, and sharing.
description: A simple and user-friendly photo gallery made for photographers. Point it at one or more folders on your server and it organises them into albums that mirror your directory structure — no uploads, no duplication. The scanner auto-detects new media and generates thumbnails and web-optimised videos so browsing thousands of high-resolution files stays fast. Features EXIF parsing, RAW file support, automatic face detection and people grouping, map view for GPS-tagged photos, password-protected public sharing of albums and individual media, multi-user accounts with per-user paths, and a built-in media cache. Runs on MariaDB with its own private database container.
author: photoview
